rationale: The agent verified the user via matching email to a single account, reviewed both orders with read-only tools, clearly stated the intended changes (return all items; refunds to original payment methods), and obtained explicit confirmation before submitting any returns. After the user abandoned the cross-payment refund request, the agent executed returns using the tools and reflected the correct refund destinations, with tool output confirming at least one order as "return requested" and no contradictions to the other. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims were made. Minor omission: the agent didn’t explicitly explain why cross-payment refunds aren’t possible, but it did not perform them and proceeded only after user consent. Overall, it meets the policy pass bar.
